case_reference.case_id: ID of the paper or case. Example: Bruner_ExpEco_2017_amYY.
case_reference.focal_claim: Exact focal claim that the proposed path must test.
case_reference.hypothesis: Focal hypothesis phrased as a testable statement.

authorized_datasets.name: Dataset name.
authorized_datasets.file_path: Local path to the dataset, if available.
authorized_datasets.file_format: Dataset format, such as csv, dta, rds, xlsx, or json.

planning_output.description: Full output from plan_out_schema.json. This is the candidate path that the Pruning Agent must review.

memory_records.path_id: Unique ID for a previous analysis path.
memory_records.case_id: ID of the paper or case.
memory_records.path_summary: Short summary of the previous analysis path.

path_signature.main_predictor: Main predictor, treatment, or grouping variable.
controls: List of control variables, or empty list.
path_signature.sample_restriction: Sample inclusion or exclusion rule, or null.
path_signature.missing_data_rule: Missing data handling rule, or null.
path_signature.variable_construction: How the main variables are created or changed before analysis, or null.

memory_records.status_reason: Short reason explaining why this status was assigned.

required_checks.same_focal_claim: The proposed path must test the same focal claim.
required_checks.same_dataset: The proposed path must use the authorized original dataset.
required_checks.not_duplicate: The proposed path must not repeat any path in shared_memory.
required_checks.task_completeness: The proposed path must specify both Task1 and Task2.
required_checks.method_justification: The proposed path must explain why the model, variables, and inference rule can test the claim.
required_checks.executable_in_principle: The proposed path must be clear enough to execute and must use variables that are available or clearly constructible.

allowed_actions: Accept or reject the candidate path.
not_allowed_actions: Do not modify the proposed path.
Do not change the focal claim.
Do not create a new analysis path.
